title: Bioelectric networks were exploited for information integration since bacterial biofilms

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Bioelectric networks were exploited for information integration since bacterial biofilms

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Evolution discovered very early, around the time of bacterial biofilms, that electrical networks of ion channels and pumps are a convenient way to integrate and process information across space and time and to scale the functions of individual cells toward large-scale tasks, the same reason brains use this modality.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology › Bioelectric control: a mechanism for scaling cell behaviors to large-scale morphogenetic goals

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: But evolution discovered very early on, around the time of bacterial biofilms [144], that electric networks are also extremely convenient ways to integrate and process information across space and time, and to scale the functions of individual computing units towards a large-scale task (the same reason that brains, and computers, use this modality [145]).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology”, Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS (2023), doi:10.1007/s00018-023-04790-z; section “Bioelectric control: a mechanism for scaling cell behaviors to large-scale morphogenetic goals”. Scope: Bacteria through metazoans

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-agential-06: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.48

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Sequence and functional databases permit restricted ancestral reconstructions and modern biofilm tests. They cannot resolve evolutionary purpose or cleanly date the proposed discovery, so only mechanistic continuity is presently testable.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Reconstruct the phylogenetic distribution and ancestral functions of ion channels, pumps, and electrical coordination, and compare biofilm-level spatial information integration with later metazoan uses. Support requires early origin plus evidence that networked information processing, not merely ion homeostasis, was ancestral.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The timing 'around bacterial biofilms' is imprecise.

Ancient function must be inferred from modern lineages.

Electrical coordination and information processing can be defined circularly.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.4
data existence: 0.62
data adequacy: 0.38
operationalizability: 0.48
analysis feasibility: 0.5

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Public protein and genome collections can test whether the relevant electrical hardware is ancient and present in bacteria, which is the dating half of the statement. Published biofilm physiology is separate and not a single deposited time series here. Neither resource records an evolutionary discovery of information processing, as opposed to cells that happen to be electrically coupled.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Date ion-channel and pump families on public bacterial and metazoan genomes and align that distribution with published biofilm electrical signalling. Channels and propagating ionic signals already present in biofilms would support early availability of the hardware; restriction of such signals to nervous systems would count against the timing.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The purpose clause, that this is why brains use the same modality, is not a separate observable.

Presence of a channel gene is not evidence that it was used to integrate information across a biofilm.
